headline: quarantine-file moves to platform built-in commands; Box and Slack event collectors get fetch fixes
summary_md:
- A small, tidy day: 7 packs move on 7 commits, one commit each, with no pack added or withdrawn.
- **AggregatedScripts** (+368/-39) migrates the `quarantine-file` script to platform built-in commands (#45533).
- Two event collectors are fixed: **Box** (+430/-32) clears a `fetch-events` Docker script timeout (#45163), and **Slack** (+206/-43) makes `slack-get-events` read a date range from its command args instead of last run (#45551).
- The rest is upkeep — Docker image bumps in **CommonScripts** (#45535) and **rasterize** (#45549), a `SyntaxWarning` fix in **GoogleSheets** (#45581), and a field moved in **MicrosoftGraphUser** (#45569).

highlights.title: Box Event Collector fixes a fetch-events Docker script timeout
highlights.detail: At +430/-32 it is the day's largest pack, carrying XSUP-72996 (#45163).

highlights.title: quarantine-file is rewritten onto platform built-in commands
highlights.detail: AggregatedScripts moves +368/-39 — the only change of the day that alters how a script does its work rather than fixing or bumping it (#45533).

highlights.title: slack-get-events now takes its date range from command args, not last run
highlights.detail: A behaviour change to the command's inputs at +206/-43, so anything driving it on the previous contract needs checking (#45551).

highlights.title: An MFA enablement field moves to the connect section
highlights.detail: MicrosoftGraphUser is the only pack moving at +16/-9, under the day's one commit subject that names no pack (#45569).

highlights.title: Two Docker image bumps land under the same ticket
highlights.detail: XSUP-71787 bumps ZipFile and UnzipFile in CommonScripts (#45535) and chromium to 151.0.7922.11855526 in rasterize (#45549).

items.Packs/Box: +430/-32 fixing a fetch-events Docker script timeout in the event collector (XSUP-72996, #45163).
items.Packs/AggregatedScripts: +368/-39 migrating the quarantine-file script to platform built-in commands (#45533).
items.Packs/Slack: +206/-43 so slack-get-events fetches a date range from command args instead of last run (#45551).
items.Packs/MicrosoftGraphUser: +16/-9 moving an MFA enablement field to the connect section (#45569).
items.Packs/CommonScripts: +13/-3 updating the ZipFile and UnzipFile Docker images to their latest tags (XSUP-71787, #45535).
items.Packs/rasterize: +8/-2 bumping the Rasterize Docker image to demisto/chromium:151.0.7922.11855526 (XSUP-71787, #45549).
